note.p: See Ed Pope: Thomas Bradley DNB 1751?-1813 Quaker physician was editor of the Medical and Physical Journal published by Richard Phillips. Boyle's 1800 Dr Thos B 3 Delahay St Westminster, Holdens 1811 Pall Mall Court. DNB (from Gents Mag 84/1) says he died St Georges Fields at the close of 1813 (which might suggest he was in King's Bench Prison).but Thomas Bradley MD of Manchester Buildings age 64 was buried at St Margaret's Westminster on 27.11.1813. I found about 8 possible Thomas Bradley marriages but couldn't identify if any of them were his. He probably only accounted for the first three entries above. In relation to the 1810 entry, Godwin noted 17.7.1810 and 13.8.1810 Kerr calls, as well as two later Kerr entries. J Kerr was a bookseller in Holborn Hill in 1810 (British Book Trades Index). In relation to the 1814 entry Godwin noted 9.3.1813 call on Harrison, Bermondsey and 13.3.1813 Harrison calls. The last entry above is 20 years further on so probably not related to any earlier ones.
We have coded only the earlier entries (not 1835).
